output.brief:
The Kestria buffering is not caused by the new CDN. It comes from the smart-TV app 5.2 release. Kestria was the only market that received it, from 9 October. The release cut the player's startup buffer from 10 s to 4 s. Smart-TV 5.2 sessions stall about 5.9% of the time. Every other client on the same CDN and the same ISPs sits at 0.6–0.7%. The pre-release test on Corvane showed the same problem (5.7% against 0.6%). The handball launch and ISP congestion don't fit the timing or the breakdowns. I'm quite sure of this (about 90%).

What to do next: don't send the breach notice, withhold fees or move traffic back to Corvane, and don't mute the alert. Revert the abr_v2 setting for Kestria. It can be done without a new app build and takes about an hour to take effect. Then hold the 20 November wider rollout until the regression is fixed. Add app version and device breakdowns to the dashboard and alerts. Hold off on the free-month offer for people who cancelled. The 1 October price rise is a competing explanation for the cancellations, and I could not separate the two. Check cancellation reasons first.
